supporting_observations.claim: Shortly before the reported account-creation time, WS-RPATEL-01 resolved WS-TWEBER-01 and established a TLS connection to it. The records do not identify the TLS application or show that it was related to account creation.

WS-TWEBER-01 exchanged Kerberos traffic with the domain controller at 13:41:16 and again at 13:43:16. These records do not identify an account-creation action or link the traffic to the alerted account.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records contain no domain account-creation audit event, account-management process event, or other record establishing who created it_support, when the creation occurred, or what permissions or groups it received.
The TLS record from WS-RPATEL-01 to WS-TWEBER-01 does not identify the application, user session, or actions performed over that connection.
The supplied evidence does not show whether the alerted account was subsequently used.
claims_not_established: That it_support was actually created at the reported time, or who created it.
That it_support was added to an administrative or other privileged group.
That the observed WS-RPATEL-01 to WS-TWEBER-01 connection caused or facilitated the account creation.
That the account creation was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain controller account-management audit events around 13:42 UTC, including account creation, enabling, group membership changes, and the initiating identity.
Directory state for it_support: creation time, SID, enabled status, group memberships, password-change history, and subsequent logons.
Endpoint process, PowerShell, and remote-session telemetry from WS-ESTONE-01, WS-RPATEL-01, and WS-TWEBER-01 for 13:20–14:20 UTC, to identify any account-management commands and their operator.
Change approval or help-desk ticket records covering the creation and intended permissions of it_support.
unrelated_findings: WS-TWEBER-01 has a UserAssist registry entry whose encoded path decodes to PowerShell; this record does not establish the command run or connect it to the alerted account. Review separately. (T067-00029)
Tom Weber ran a WMIC command querying OS caption, version, and architecture on WS-TWEBER-01. It is not shown to be related to the account alert. (T067-00032, T067-00033)

WS-TWEBER-01 made PostgreSQL connections to multiple internal hosts; the supplied evidence does not establish their purpose or relation to the alert. Review separately. (T067-00123, T067-00179, T067-00207, T067-00213)

WS-TWEBER-01 resolved afemode.pinecrest.local to 10.51.20.110 and then made a TCP connection attempt to port 1433 that did not establish. This is not linked to the alerted account. (T067-00197, T067-00205)
